prompt_en: {catname} finds a giant pile of cat pelts... How terrible!

prompt_en:
{catname} comes upon a charming little clam.

It's so... beautiful! {He} feels a growing urge to lean in closer...
prompt_zh:
{catname}遇到一个迷猫的小鲍鱼。

它真的……好美啊！{He}忍不住想要再凑近一些……

{catname}发现一扇旧窗户。

玻璃上满是裂纹，阳光下一闪一闪的，乍一看像是很多小镜子拼起来的，感觉随时都可能碎掉。

prompt_zh: {catname}发现一个计算机控制台，上面密密麻麻全是按钮和旋钮。

prompt_en: {catname} discovers a large crack in the earth. Who knows how far down it leads?
prompt_zh: {catname}发现地上裂开了一道大口子。谁能知道这裂缝有多深呢？

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a large crashed mechanical object!

Maybe it is some kind of large robot or ship?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一个坠毁的大型机械装置！

也许是什么大型机器人，或者飞船？

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a large wooden crate. It appears to be in good condition...

{catname} wonders what treasures could be inside?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一个大木箱，看起来保存得还不错……

{catname}想知道里边会藏着什么宝贝？

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a dark cave in the ground.

{He} can smell the musky odor of a large animal, perhaps resting within the den.
prompt_zh:
{catname}在地上发现个黑洞洞的兽穴。

{He}闻到一股大型动物的腥臊气味，说不定洞里正歇着个大家伙。

prompt_en: {catname} finds a deceased cat, its body sprawled out in contortions from the pain it experienced in its final moments of life...
prompt_zh: {catname}发现了一只死猫，它四肢张开，身体扭曲，看样子死得很痛苦……

prompt_en: Beneath a towering mound of ice and fur, {catname} sees a dead mammoth.
prompt_zh: 眼前那座“大山”像是冰和毛皮垒成的，可{catname}定睛一看，发现原来是一头死了的猛犸。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a dead rat...

Stench from the corpse fills {his} nose, a powerful but intriguing smell.
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一只死老鼠……

尸体的腐臭直往鼻子里钻，闻起来又冲又上头。

prompt_en: {catname} comes across the decaying remains of a long dead creature. It appears to move slightly, but {he} thinks it might have just been the numerous insects slowly devouring it.
prompt_zh: {catname}遇到一具尸骸，应该死了很久，已经腐烂得不成样子。它好像稍微动了一下，但{he}觉得应该是错觉，大概是因为上面爬满了虫子，正在慢慢地吞噬它。

prompt_en:
A large demonic statue sits before {catname}.

It clutches a large bowl in its hands and asks for a sacrifice!
prompt_zh:
{catname}眼前杵着一座巨大的恶魔雕像。

它手里捧着一只大钵，是在索要祭品！

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a dumpster. Oddly, there is a lock keeping it shut...

Why would you lock a dumpster?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一个垃圾箱。奇怪的是，它居然上了锁……

谁会给垃圾箱上锁啊？

prompt_en:
A dust storm ahead is blowing debris and sand everywhere.

Inside the dust storm {catname} sees the silhouette of a figure...
prompt_zh:
前方一场沙尘暴正刮得昏天暗地，碎屑和黄沙漫天乱飞。

在风沙里，{catname}看见一个影影绰绰的身影……

prompt_en: {catname} finds a dying fetus, quivering in fright and pain.
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一个垂死的胎儿，正因恐惧和疼痛瑟瑟发抖。

prompt_en:
Molten, glowing, radioactive waste slowly oozes from a fissure in the wall.

Even from this distance {catname} can feel a strange heat radiating from the elephant's foot on {his} soft skin.
prompt_zh:
熔融的、发着光的辐射废料从墙缝里慢慢渗出。

就算隔了段不小的距离，{catname}娇嫩的皮肤，也能感觉到远处那个“象脚”散发出的诡异热气。

prompt_en:
Heat from the elephant's foot now permeates every cell of {catname}'s body...

{catname} imagines this might be what it feels like to be nestled in {his} mother's womb.
prompt_zh:
“象脚”散发的热气开始渗进{catname}的每一个细胞……

恍惚间，{catname}觉得，也许在妈妈肚子里时就是这种感觉。

prompt_en:
Where is {he}? Is this hell? Is this heaven?

{His} brain is boiling yet {catname} wonders if {he} can hold out... just a little longer!
prompt_zh:
{he}这是在哪里？是地狱？还是天堂？

{His}脑子正在沸腾，{catname}却还在犹豫：自己能不能……再撑一会儿，就一小会儿！

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a small, helpless fetus lying on the floor.

It stares up at {him} with large, round eyes.
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一个小胎儿，无助地蜷在地上。

它圆圆的大眼睛望着{him}。

prompt_en: A giant stone fountain sits in front of {catname}. It's pouring water majestically.
prompt_zh: {catname}眼前矗立着一座巨大的石头喷泉，泉水落下，特别壮观。

prompt_en:
[i]"OK! You! What better?

Boogers? Or poop!"[/i]
prompt_zh:
“好！你！哪个好？

鼻屎？还是㞎㞎！”

prompt_en:
[i]"Bet you never guess what best…

Beepis or feebis?"[/i]
prompt_zh:
“你肯定不知道哪个好……

比皮斯还是菲比斯？”

prompt_en:
A large block of ice is before {catname}.

Looking deep into the ice, {catname} can see a humanoid figure frozen within!
prompt_zh:
{catname}眼前有好大一块冰。

{catname}往冰里头仔细一看，发现里面好像冻着个人！

prompt_en: {catname} discovers a basket of fruit. The warm smell of fresh citrus and bananas lingers in the air. A refreshing reprieve!
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一篮水果。空气里是新鲜柑橘和香蕉的暖心香气，真是神清气爽，能暂时缓一口气了！

prompt_en:
{catname} finds an odd looking antique lamp.

For some reason, {catname} feels a sudden urge to rub it with {his} paw.
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一盏造型古怪的古董灯。

不知怎么地，{catname}突然很想伸出爪子搓搓它。

prompt_en:
[i]"How rude of you to bother me, the Genie of the Lamp, from my rest! I curse thee!

But I'm feeling... [b]generous[/b] today... so I will let you choose your own demise!"[/i]

The Genie cackles in glee at {catname}'s distress.
prompt_zh:
“竟敢打扰本神灯精灵休息，真是无礼至极！我要诅咒你！

不过我今天……[b]还有点善心[/b]……就让你自己选个死法吧！”

精灵看着{catname}那副窘样，幸灾乐祸地笑了起来。

prompt_en:
[i]"Hello my furry friend!

I, the Genie of the Lamp, grant you a wish!

What shall it be then?"[/i]
prompt_zh:
“你好啊，毛茸茸的朋友！

我是神灯精灵，可以帮你实现一个愿望！

说吧，想要什么？”

prompt_en: A giant sleeping shark blocks the way forward in front of {catname}!
prompt_zh: 一头沉睡的巨鲨堵在{catname}眼前，挡住了去路！

prompt_en: {catname} finds a metal grate. Could it lead to somewhere else?
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一个金属格栅。这底下能去别的地方吗？

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a grotesque mound of guts heaped into a large pile...

What a strange sight!
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一堆内脏，层层叠叠垒在一起，被恶心坏了……

这场面也太诡异了！

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a hairball made of chunks of fur and hair.

It has small bones sticking out of it. It's honestly quite disgusting... Or is it?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现了一大团毛发结成的毛球。

上面还戳着几根小骨头。说实话挺恶心的……不过，这话可能说得有点早？

prompt_en:
A wrinkly, withered old head is tucked in the ring of a tire.

It stares blankly at {catname}.
prompt_zh:
轮胎圈里卡着一颗皱巴巴、干瘪的头。

一双眼睛呆滞地盯着{catname}。

prompt_en: A deep hole in the Earth lies before {catname}. Orange red light dances up from something burning deep below...
prompt_zh: {catname}前方的地上有个很深的洞。洞的深处有什么东西在燃烧，橘红色的火光跳动着往上窜……

prompt_en:
A skull lies before {catname}. The unblinking eyes of the skull stare at {him} like endless dark pits.

{catname} fights the urge to sit and stare into the skull forever...
prompt_zh:
{catname}眼前有个骷髅头。两只眼睛盯着{him}，一眨不眨，像望不到底的深坑。

{catname}生出一股冲动，想要坐下来和它对视到天荒地老，但还是忍住了……

prompt_en:
{catname} sees something ahead. At first {he} is unable to distinguish the strange lump hanging loosely from the ceiling.

{His} ears go back and {his} eyes grow wide as {he} realizes it is the skin of a human head, dry and boneless...
prompt_zh:
{catname}看到前面有个东西。{he}一开始没认出来天花板上松垮垮垂下来到底是什么怪东西。

{His}耳朵向后竖着，眼睛也瞪得老大——{he}发现竟然是人头上剥下来的一张皮，干瘪瘪的……

prompt_en: [i]"Spare some change to help my nona?"[/i]
prompt_zh: “行行好，给我点钱救救我阿婆吧？”

prompt_en: A jagged pathway leads downward ahead, riddled with bones and sharp rocks...
prompt_zh: 前面有一条崎岖的小路一路向下，遍地是白骨和尖利的石头……

prompt_en:
{catname} howls in pain at the giant stalactite buried in {his} skull!

The other cats bet they could help {him} by pulling it out... Should they?
prompt_zh:
{catname}头上插着一大根钟乳石，痛得叫出了声！

其他猫猫在商量要不要帮{him}拔出来……要拔吗？

prompt_en: {catname} finds a knife stuck in a wall.
prompt_zh: {catname}发现有面墙上插着一把刀。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a strange lump of pulsating meat hanging down from the ceiling.

Maybe it leaked through from another floor?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现天花板上垂下来一团古怪的肉，还在一突一突地搏动。

会不会是从上面那层漏下来的？

prompt_en: {catname} finds a locked crate.
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一个上锁的箱子。

prompt_en: A door bars the way forward. It looks like it could be locked. What should {catname} do?
prompt_zh: 一扇门挡住了去路，看样子好像上了锁。{catname}该怎么办？

prompt_en: While walking through the junkyard, {catname} spots a rusty old car. {He} feels a strong urge to look in the trunk, still locked after all these years.
prompt_zh: {catname}穿过汽车坟场时，看见一辆锈迹斑斑的旧车。{He}突然有股冲动，想看看后备箱里头有什么，都这么多年了，居然还锁着。

prompt_en: While travelling, {catname} finds a locket. It appears to be in decent condition.
prompt_zh: {catname}半路发现了一个盒式吊坠，看着成色还不错。

prompt_en: [i]"GOLEM THANK YOU RESCUE HIM FROM CRYPT! NOW GOLEM HELP YOU!"[/i]
prompt_zh: “魔像谢谢你救他出墓穴！现在魔像帮你！”

prompt_en: At the heart of a small crater, {catname} finds a strange vibrating meteor!
prompt_zh: {catname}在一个小型陨石坑的中央，发现一块还在振动的陨石，看着就很古怪！

prompt_en: {catname} squints {his} eyes, peering through the hot shimmering air. {He} thinks {he} sees something on the horizon!
prompt_zh: {catname}眯起眼睛，看着远处蒸腾的热浪。{He}觉得地平线上好像有什么东西！

prompt_en:
{catname} comes upon a strange mirror...

Although {he} can see {his} reflection, {catname}'s movements appear oddly delayed and distorted.
prompt_zh:
{catname}撞见一面诡异的镜子……

{he}虽然能在镜子里看到自己，但里头的{catname}动作总慢半拍，样子也很扭曲。

prompt_en: {catname} discovers a strange disembodied hand. The fingers of the hand are raised upward, unmoving.
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一只诡异的断手，手指朝上竖着，一动不动。

prompt_en: {catname} comes upon a large monkey hand. It has three fingers raised up into the air.
prompt_zh: {catname}一路走着，撞见一只巨大的猴爪，三根手指竖起。

prompt_en: {catname} finds a strange hand, with one finger down and two up.

prompt_en: {catname} finds a strange hand, with one finger down and two up.

prompt_en: The monkey paw grants {catname} a wish!
prompt_zh: 猴爪应了{catname}的一个愿望！

prompt_en: {catname} finds a nest full of mice. They seem to be sleeping for the moment...
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一窝老鼠，好像都睡着了……

prompt_en: {catname} finds a mousetrap with a tasty looking fish on it. What should {he} do?
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一个捕鼠夹，上面放了条看着很好吃的鱼。{he}该怎么办？

prompt_en:
{catname} comes across a mummified corpse.

The body is dried and hardened, frozen in time in the tragic pose of its final moment.
prompt_zh:
{catname}撞见一具木乃伊化的死猫。

尸体已经干枯硬化，保持着惨死的姿势。

prompt_en: {catname} has found a large mushroom. What should {he} do with it?
prompt_zh: {catname}发现好大一棵蘑菇。{He}该拿它怎么办？

prompt_en:
A mysterious building looms ahead. {catname} approaches cautiously...

An open doorway leads within, but {catname}'s eyes cannot pierce into the shadowed interior.
prompt_zh:
前方赫然立着一座神秘的建筑，{catname}小心翼翼地靠近……

一扇门敞开着，通向建筑内部，可门里黑漆漆的，{catname}看不见里面有什么。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a mysterious cave. {He} can hear scary voices echoing from within the cave...

The darkness entrance beckons {catname} to explore it.
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一个神秘洞穴。洞里回荡着恐怖的声音，飘进了{He}的耳朵……

漆黑的洞口像是有什么魔力，勾着{catname}进去一探究竟。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a rope tied above a deep shaft that leads into an abyss.

Should {he} rappel down into the chasm?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现深井上系了条绳子，井口下面深不见底。

{he}要不要顺着绳子降到底下去？

prompt_en:
A strange glowing figure sits before {catname}!

Power emanates from its body and strange words from the being echo in {catname}'s mind.
prompt_zh:
{catname}眼前坐着个怪模怪样、浑身发光的家伙！

那家伙身上透着一股劲儿，嘴里念叨的话一句都听不懂，直接在{catname}脑子里回荡。

prompt_en:
{catname} turns to the base of the rope and looks up...

It sure is a long way back up to the entrance of the cave!
prompt_zh:
{catname}转身走到绳子底下，抬头一看……

想回洞口还得爬好长一段路！

prompt_en:
In the center of a room {catname} finds mysterious chamber with a large chair inside.

Within the enclosure, {catname} finds 3 labelled buttons.
prompt_zh:
{catname}在房间中央发现一个神秘的舱，里头摆着把大椅子。

舱里还有3个标着字的按钮。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a mysterious crater in the ground.

{He} can't see what lies in shadow at the bottom, but {catname} thinks {he} could find a way down.
prompt_zh:
{catname}在地上发现一个神秘的陨石坑。

坑底藏在阴影里，{catname}看不清里头有什么，不过{he}觉得可以想办法下去看看。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a strange creature, its body deformed and distorted into a hideous mass of flesh.

{catname} can't determine what type of animal it was before it... mutated?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一只诡异的生物，它的身体扭曲变形之后，成了一坨吓人的肉团。

它这是……突变了吗？{catname}完全看不出来它原来是什么动物。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a large mysterious jar.

prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一个大罐子，看起来很神秘。

透过浑浊的液体，{catname}能看见里面困着一个小家伙。

With a blood-curdling scream, the mummy attacks {catname}!

prompt_en:
{catname} finds several syringes full of a unknown colored liquids.

prompt_en:
{catname} finds an oasis with a small shaded pool of water. 

{catname}'s dry throat longs for a wet reprieve from the endless dry heat of the desert...

{catname}遇到一处绿洲，树荫下有个小水池。

prompt_en: {catname} finds an odd device with buttons and a lever controlling a robotic device.

prompt_en:

prompt_en:
A giant wall of flesh and pulsating veins blocks the way before {catname}.

{He} notices there is a strange cube shaped indent in the wall.
prompt_zh:
一堵巨大的血肉墙挡住了{catname}的去路，墙上的血管还在突突地跳。

{He}注意到，墙上有一个古怪的方形凹槽。

prompt_en: There is a wall of veins with a lump of throbbing gristle embedded in it. The flesh that was once there has rotted away.
prompt_zh: 眼前是一堵血管墙，上面嵌着一块还在搏动的软骨。原先那层肉，已经烂没了。

prompt_en:
In a dimly lit corner {catname} finds an old magazine.

After brushing off the dust, {he} discovers it's a copy of PlayCat!
prompt_zh:
{catname}在昏暗的角落翻出一本旧杂志。

{he}拍掉封面上的灰尘，发现居然是本《花喵公子》！

prompt_en: A mob of rats scurry all around, charging at {catname}!
prompt_zh: 一群老鼠吱吱乱窜，朝{catname}冲了过来！

prompt_en: {catname} discovers a hunk of rotting meat, partially decomposed.
prompt_zh: {catname}发现一大块烂肉，有一部分已经分解了。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a locked safe.

Although worn with age, the locking mechanism appears secure.
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一个上了锁的保险柜。

虽然有些年头了，但密码锁看样子还是很牢靠。

prompt_en:
{catname} finds a severed head lying on the ground. Its unblinking eye stares right through {him}.

What should {he} do?
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现地上有个脑袋。上面那只眼睛一眨不眨，直直瞪着，像能把{him}看穿一样。

{he}该怎么办？

prompt_en: Beneath the surface of a murky pool of water {catname} spies something shiny!
prompt_zh: {catname}透过浑浊的池水，瞥见底下好像有什么发光的东西！

prompt_en:
{catname} spies a cute little bird.

It looks very soft... And also very tasty!
prompt_zh:
{catname}发现一只可爱的小鸟。

看着软乎乎的……感觉应该很好吃！

prompt_en: A small black hole beckons {catname} toward it, pulling at every hair on {his} body...
prompt_zh: 一个小型黑洞在召唤{catname}，拉扯着{He}身上的每一根毛……

prompt_en:
A putrid stench is on the air.

{catname} wrinkles {his} nose as {he} finds the source, an incredibly smelly bag.
prompt_zh:
空气里飘着恶心的臭味。

{catname}皱起鼻子循着味道找过去，发现源头是一个臭到离谱的袋子。

prompt_en:
{catname} hears something whispering from the darkness...

Should the party keep on going forward?
prompt_zh:
{catname}听见黑暗里有什么东西在低声说话……

队伍还要继续往前走吗？

prompt_en: Dense cobwebs line the walls and ceiling, blocking {catname}'s way forward.
prompt_zh: 墙上和天花板上爬满了厚厚的蜘蛛网，挡住了{catname}的去路。

prompt_en: {catname} finds a spooky apparition! Spectral tears wash silently down its face as it watches {his} every move...
prompt_zh: {catname}遇到一个阴森的幽灵！它脸上的泪无声滑落，死死盯着{his}一举一动……

The legs of a deceased human are sticking out of the ground.

一道高得吓人的栅栏挡在了{catname}眼前！
